subject: Re: Voucher exchange for mid-cycle uplift - options and PO timing
messages:
From: Amelia Ford <amelia@lumosai.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Evan Li <evan.li@lumosai.com>, procurement@lumosai.com
Date: 2025-05-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Options for mid-cycle uplift — voucher / credit exchange

Hi Grace / Ben,

Quick context: we're seeing a 40% usage spike for the next two quarters as we pilot multimodal features. Legal and procurement pushed back on a full uplift because our fiscal year alignment is tight, but they'd consider an upfront credit or voucher that converts to committed capacity at renewal.

Can Redwood outline (a) an upfront credit/voucher structure we can buy now that would be applied to future committed units, and (b) an alternative where we pay a smaller committed uplift now with a mid-contract true-up? We need something procurement can approve quickly (PO + invoice) and finance needs clear amortization guidance.

Attachment: LumosAI_PO_template.docx (docx)

Thanks — Amelia
Procurement, LumosAI
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: Amelia Ford <amelia@lumosai.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2025-05-14T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Options for mid-cycle uplift — voucher / credit exchange

Amelia — thanks for the note and the PO template. Quick read-through and here are two pragmatic paths that close faster while protecting LumosAI on unit economics.

1) Upfront voucher (preferred for procurement):
- Buy a prepaid credit bundle (non-expiring for 18 months) equal to X tokens / Y embedding units.
- Voucher applied first-to-consumption across hosted and dedicated usage.
- At renewal, voucher remaining balance can be (a) converted to committed units at a negotiated uplift rate or (b) refunded pro rata if you choose not to commit.
- Tradeoff: ~6% discount on list for upfront payment + limited rollover term.

2) Small committed uplift + true-up (preferred for finance):
- Commit to a modest uplift (e.g., +30% baseline capacity) billed monthly.
- Automatic true-up at mid-contract (90 days) to reconcile actual usage; you either pay incremental usage at the committed rate or roll it into next renewal at a pre-agreed uplift band.
- Tradeoff: lower upfront cash, but slightly higher unit price for consumption above commitment.

I'll attach a sample quote with both options out of finance for PO review. If procurement can sign the PO for the voucher path, we can invoice within 5 business days.

Attachment: RI-Quote-v3.pdf (pdf)

Would you like a short (20 min) call tomorrow to walk through terms with Finance / Procurement?

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Amelia Ford <amelia@lumosai.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2025-05-14T13:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Options for mid-cycle uplift — voucher / credit exchange

Love the two-path framing — a couple tactical clarifications from pricing:
- For the voucher path we can extend a one-time conversion credit at renewal (up to 25% of remaining voucher) if the account converts to a 12-month commit within 90 days of renewal; this helps LumosAI amortize.
- For the small-commit path, we can cap the true-up price to the committed uplift rate + 2% to avoid surprise spikes.

Amelia — if you confirm the expected token/embedding volumes approximately, I can lock the numbers in and send a PO-ready quote.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Evan Li <evan.li@lumosai.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@lumosai.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2025-05-15T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Options for mid-cycle uplift — voucher / credit exchange

Thanks Grace / Ben — useful options. Procurement prefers the voucher path because it maps cleanly to their PO cycles. A few asks from Finance: (1) can you confirm amortization treatment (12 vs 18 months) in writing? (2) we need a clear line item in the quote for the refundable portion if we opt not to convert at renewal.

Estimated consumption for the next 6 months we're budgeting: ~45B tokens + 120k embeddings. That's an upper-bound estimate — we'll likely use ~70-80% of that.

If you can send the PO-ready quote with those line items, procurement will try to get sign-off this week. We can do a 15-min sync on Monday to finalize.

— Evan Li
Head of Finance, LumosAI
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Evan Li <evan.li@lumosai.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2025-05-16T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Options for mid-cycle uplift — voucher / credit exchange

Evan — appreciate the estimates. We will produce a PO-ready quote with:
- Voucher line: subtotal, discount (6%), non-expiry window 18 months, refundable remainder clause (pro rata refund scenario called out).
- Conversion credit line: conditional 25% convert-credit if you commit to 12 months within 90 days of renewal.
- Amortization guidance: recommended 18 months for internal accounting but we'll include both 12- and 18-month amortization tables for your finance team.

Ben will push the final numbers into the quote today and I'll send via HubSpot + the DocuSign-ready PDF.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Pricing & Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
